description: This file defines the React component 'SmartSuggestions', which displays recommended product suggestions based on past orders. It fetches suggestions from a service, supports dismissing suggestions, and allows adding suggested items back to the cart.

methods.name: SmartSuggestions({ location = "cart", limit = 5, onAdded })
methods.description: React functional component that manages and displays product suggestions based on user past orders. Handles fetching suggestions, dismissing them, and re-adding products to cart.

methods.name: addAgain
methods.description: Adds a suggested product back to the cart using the product ID; prompts login if user is not authenticated.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Marks a suggestion as dismissed so it is no longer visible in the suggestions list.
